suite: ic tool programme conformance suite v1
rules: A case passes only if the process exits within its timeout, never panics (exit status 101), and meets every expectation.
{tmp} is the case's own temporary directory; {suite} is research/ic_tool_program/suite/v1.
Cases are added, never removed or loosened; a case's expectation changes only with a dated note in this file.
